sourceRefs.locator: Paragraphs around notes 84–88. Athalaric, his minority and his mother Amalasuentha’s regency, the accession letters and the promised continuation of rights.

summary.de: Theoderichs Tochter übernahm 526 die Regentschaft für ihren minderjährigen Sohn Athalarich. Die Schreiben zum Regierungsantritt baten die Adressaten um einen Treueid.
summary.en: Theoderic’s daughter became regent for her young son Athalaric in 526. The accession letters called upon their recipients to swear loyalty.
